cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
if(POLICY CMP0167)
  cmake_policy(SET CMP0167 OLD)
endif()
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/Modules")

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  set(FPSOLVE_IS_TOP_LEVEL ON)
else()
  set(FPSOLVE_IS_TOP_LEVEL OFF)
endif()

project(fpsolve LANGUAGES C CXX)

if(DEFINED ENV{BOOST_ROOT})
  set(Boost_NO_SYSTEM_PATHS true)
endif()

find_package(Boost COMPONENTS filesystem program_options system REQUIRED)
find_package(GMP REQUIRED)
find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)

option(USE_GENEPI "Use genepi and semilinear-set NDD support" ON)
option(USE_LIBFA "Use libfa and lossy finite automata support" ON)
option(FPSOLVE_BUILD_TOOLS "Build command-line tools" ${FPSOLVE_IS_TOP_LEVEL})
option(FPSOLVE_BUILD_TESTS "Build unit tests" ${FPSOLVE_IS_TOP_LEVEL})

if(USE_GENEPI)
  if(PKG_CONFIG_FOUND)
    pkg_check_modules(GENEPI QUIET genepi)
  endif()
  if(NOT GENEPI_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "Genepi not found; disabling USE_GENEPI")
    set(USE_GENEPI OFF)
  endif()
endif()

if(USE_LIBFA)
  if(PKG_CONFIG_FOUND)
    pkg_check_modules(LIBFA QUIET libfa)
  endif()
  if(NOT LIBFA_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "libfa not found; disabling USE_LIBFA")
    set(USE_LIBFA OFF)
  endif()
endif()

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

add_subdirectory(lib)
if(FPSOLVE_BUILD_TOOLS)
  add_subdirectory(tools)
endif()

if(FPSOLVE_BUILD_TESTS)
  find_package(GTest REQUIRED)
  add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
